blind.description: A stylized medieval or rustic clothesline consisting of two vertical wooden posts anchored on square plinths, with rope tied around their tops and brackets holding a central clothesline. Hanging from the line are various pieces of drying laundry: two small green cloths on the ends, a large folded off-white linen sheet or shirt, a lace-up beige tunic, and a reddish-brown folded skirt or apron.
blind.from_above: A straight thin horizontal line flanked by two square post tops, with the ruffled, overlapping top edges of hanging fabric bunched along the center line.
blind.height_vs_figure: The wooden posts stand around 4 to 4.5 feet tall (about three-quarters the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure), and the line spans approximately 8 to 10 feet wide.
